title: When Agent Metrics Measure Different Things: An Evidence-Grounded Audit of the Praxa AI Pipeline
abstract: arXiv:2609.12017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent evaluations can be numerically correct while measuring a different construct from the one implied by their labels. We present a retrospective measurement audit of selected Praxa AI implementation files, historical evaluation artifacts, and operational records. A 139-case offline routing report contains 112 passes and 27 failures despite zero gating failures, because known gaps are explicitly exempted from the gate. An identifier-free export represents 8,843 tool-attempt rows: 8,395 recorded durations and 448 missing values. Of the durations, 121 equal the signed 32-bit maximum and carry abandoned-client labels; inspected database code clamps elapsed lifecycle age. The pooled recorded 99th percentile is 2,147,483,647 ms, versus 38,118.31 ms among server-observed completed calls. This is a stratum contrast, not a treatment effect. translated_title: 当智能体指标衡量的是不同事物时：对 Praxa AI 流水线的基于证据审计
translated_abstract: 智能体评估可能在数值上正确，但其实际测量的构念却与其标签所暗示的并不一致。我们对选定的 Praxa AI 实现文件、历史评估产物和运营记录进行了回顾性测量审计。一份包含 139 个案例的离线路由报告显示 112 个通过、27 个失败，但门控失败数为零，这是因为已知的缺陷被明确豁免于门控之外。一份不含标识符的导出数据包含 8,843 条工具调用尝试记录：其中 8,395 条记录了耗时，448 条数值缺失。在这些已记录的耗时中，有 121 条等于带符号 32 位整数的最大值（2,147,483,647 毫秒），并带有“客户放弃”标签；经检查的数据库代码会对生命周期经过时间进行钳制处理。汇总记录的第 99 百分位耗时为 2,147,483,647 毫秒，而在服务器实际观测到的已完成调用中该值仅为 38,118.31 毫秒——这是一个分层间的对比，而非处理效应。在一项有记录的单轨迹上下文压缩试点中，报告的后续输入缩减比例为 94.39%，但……
tldr: 通过对 Praxa AI 流水线的回顾性证据审计，本文揭示智能体评估指标可能数值正确却与标签含义不符——通过率因豁免已知缺陷而虚高、延迟统计被 32 位整型上限钳制值污染、压缩收益与实际不符，凸显了指标测量效度审计的必要性。
en_tdlr: This retrospective evidence-grounded audit of the Praxa AI pipeline shows that agent evaluation metrics can be numerically correct yet measure different constructs than their labels imply, with pass rates inflated by exemptions, latency statistics corrupted by 32-bit integer clamping, and compression savings not matching reality.
